steps.action: Dolphin in Columns view: clicks 'tmp' in the root column
clicks folder 'bug report': next column shows 'sub folder' and a file with a very long name 'Lorem Ipsum is simply dummy text of the printing and typesetting industry...'
the column with 'sub folder' and the long file name now fills the whole view width; the new column with sub folder's contents is off-screen
scrolls horizontally (scrollbar at bottom): the 'compact / detials / icons' column comes into view at the right (08.2-09.2)

clicks in that column: view jumps so that only the 'compact / detials / icons' column is visible at the left, rest empty (09.5-15.3); clicks 'compact', 'detials', 'icons' (10-15): only selection and status bar change
resizes the window (right edge moves in): layout reflows to show all columns (root, tmp, bug report, sub folder) with the long name truncated '...printing and t...rarian at St Bride...'

actual: After opening 'sub folder' (06.5) the column holding the ~200-character file name expands to the full window width (07.0), pushing the next column out of view; the user has to scroll horizontally to see it (08.2). Clicking further folders leaves the view scrolled to a single narrow column with empty space (09.5-15.3) instead of the normal multi-column layout. Only after a window resize at 15.5 does Dolphin show all columns with the long name truncated.
decisive: 00:07.0: the 'sub folder' column with the long file name spans the whole view, the contents column of 'sub folder' is not visible; versus 00:16.5 after resize, all four columns visible with the name truncated
not_visible: exact length of the file name (~200 chars) beyond what is on screen
notes: 1920x1080 at 60 fps, text small; read from full-res crops. The resize at 15.5 is inferred from the window edge moving, the drag itself is barely visible. Folder 'detials' is spelled so on screen.
